बॉलीवुड के किंग शाह रुख खान 3 साल के गैप के बाद एक बार फिर बॉक्स ऑफिस पर बहुत बड़ा धमाका करने के लिए तैयार हैं! 💥

शाह रुख खान की मच अवेटेड एक्शन थ्रिलर फिल्म King इस साल 24 December को क्रिसमस के फेस्टिव सीजन पर सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होने जा रही है। Pathaan और Jawan की अपार सफलता के बाद किंग खान एक बार फिर फुल-फ्लेज्ड एक्शन रोल में तहलका मचाएंगे। 🎬

बता दें कि Pathaan ने ओपनिंग डे पर 104.26 Crore और Jawan ने 128.1 Crore का वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन किया था। अब अगर King भी 100 Crore प्लस की ओपनिंग लेती है, तो शाह रुख खान 3 ग्लोबल 100 Crore ओपनर देने वाले बॉलीवुड के पहले एक्टर बनकर इतिहास रच देंगे! 🔥

यह फिल्म Jawan का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ सकती है और Dhurandhar 2 व Ramayana के बाद बॉलीवुड की तीसरी 150 Crore ओपनर भी बन सकती है। Siddharth Anand के डायरेक्शन और Red Chillies Entertainment व Marflix Pictures के बैनर तले बनी इस फिल्म में Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor और Rani Mukerji मुख्य भूमिकाओं में हैं। ✨

क्या आपको लगता है कि Shah Rukh Khan की King पहले ही दिन Jawan का 128.1 Crore का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 🤔

ctx.title: King Box Office: Shah Rukh Khan Eyes History With Another Potential 100 Crore Worldwide Opener!
ctx.summary:
Shah Rukh Khan is all set to make a roaring comeback at the box office with his highly anticipated Christmas release, King. 
 The post  King Box Office: Shah Rukh Khan Eyes History With Another Potential 100 Crore Worldwide Opener!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Shah Rukh Khan is all set to make a smashing comeback after a gap of three years, with his highly anticipated King. The magnum opus is scheduled to release in theaters on December 24th this year. The excitement is at its peak as the superstar will be returning in a full-fledged action role just like Pathaan and Jawan . Since he has two 1000-crore grossers worldwide in the post-COVID era, box-office enthusiasts have pinned high hopes on his next. Besides this, Shah Rukh looks forward to making history with another 100 crore opener.
The upcoming action thriller is releasing during the Christmas festive season, which increases the film’s opening-day potential. Given the genuine hype and the fact that the makers will be putting their best foot forward to create awareness about the film, a massive start is on the cards. It is likely to break Shah Rukh’s existing opening-day record held by Jawan ( 128.1 crore ).
Till now, no Bollywood actor has delivered three 100 crore openers globally, and now, with King, Shah Rukh Khan is ready to script history. Pathaan was his first 100-crore opener, with a 104.26-crore gross on day 1. Jawan marked its second-century opener with a 128.1 crore gross. With King, he’s likely to score another 100 crore opener, making it three for him. After Dhurandhar 2 and Ramayana, it might even become Bollywood’s third 150 crore opener.
Ranbir Kapoor, after Animal , will deliver his second 100-crore opener with Ramayana, tying the score with Shah Rukh Khan. But next month, Shah Rukh will make history with three 100 crore global openers.
King is directed by Siddharth Anand and produced by Gauri Khan, Mamta Anand, and Siddharth Anand under the banner of Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures. It also stars Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Jackie Shroff, Arshad Warsi, Raghav Juyal, and Abhay Verma.
